verified.review_note: The official Premier League squad list and archived Sheffield United signing announcement identify Bénie Adama Traoré with Sheffield United. Live read-only SQLite maps canonical player 1503 to FPL code 523957 and Sheffield United in 2023-24. Transfermarkt, Soccerway and Soccerbase each give the exact date 2002-11-30. The competing Wikidata 2002-11-22 claim has no supporting reference in the checked claims, so the independently corroborated exact date is used.

The official Premier League squad list identifies Fulham U21's Charlie James Robinson. Soccerbase lists his Fulham and Fulham U21 career from 2022 and gives 19 September 2004; Transfermarkt independently gives the same full name, Fulham U21 association and date. Live read-only SQLite maps canonical player 1613 to FPL code 547673 at Fulham in 2022-23, matching this academy defender rather than a namesake.

The official Premier League 2020-21 registered-under-21 list identifies Sheffield United's Francis William Maguire. Transfermarkt's Frankie Maguire record gives the same full name and exact date 29 July 2003. Live read-only SQLite maps canonical player 2035 to FPL code 531076 and Sheffield United in 2020-21, confirming the club-and-season identity match.

unresolved.reason: Live read-only SQLite maps FPL code 490095 to Wolves in 2023-24; the official Premier League squad list identifies Wolves U21's Ty Kimoni Barnett. The Wolves Academy archive profile and official contract notices confirm the player but publish no exact DOB. The first-contract notice calls him 17 on 11 August 2022 and the extension notice calls him 18 on 15 August 2023; both 2005-08-03 and 2005-07-19 fit those age statements. Transfermarkt and Wikipedia give 3 August, while Wikidata and Wolves Complete History give 19 July. No checked primary record supplies an exact date to settle that conflict, so no DOB is assigned.

Live read-only SQLite maps FPL code 100180 to Danilo Luiz da Silva at Manchester City in 2017-18, 2018-19 and 2019-20. Manchester City's official signing article confirms the identity but only gives an age compatible with both proposed dates. Real Madrid's official archived player profile explicitly gives 15 July 1991; the FIFA 2018 World Cup squad list is cited for the competing 16 July 1991 infobox value, while Transfermarkt also gives 15 July. Because the official-source record trail is not reconciled, no exact DOB is assigned.
